mapper.select: SELECT id FROM identity_user WHERE id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id
FROM identity_user
WHERE id=#{userId}
AND is_enabled
AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN pending_time_zone IS NOT NULL
AND time_zone_effective_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN pending_time_zone ELSE time_zone END
FROM identity_user
WHERE id=#{userId}
AND is_enabled
AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id,s.version,s.goal_id,s.status,g.archived_at
FROM stage s
JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id
AND g.user_id=s.user_id
AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE s.id=#{id}
AND s.user_id=#{userId}
AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT t.id,t.version,t.stage_id,s.goal_id,t.status,g.archived_at,g.name AS goal_name,s.name AS stage_name,a.weekly_plan_id,a.daily_plan_id,
CASE WHEN a.id IS NULL THEN 'POOL' WHEN a.daily_plan_id IS NULL THEN 'WEEK' ELSE 'DAY' END AS assignment_status
FROM task t
JOIN stage s ON s.id=t.stage_id
AND s.user_id=t.user_id
AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
JOIN goal g ON g.id=s.goal_id
AND g.user_id=t.user_id
AND g.deleted_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN task_assignment a ON a.task_id=t.id
AND a.user_id=t.user_id
AND a.ended_at IS NULL
WHERE t.id=#{id}
AND t.user_id=#{userId}
AND t.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.id,d.version,d.weekly_plan_id,d.plan_date,w.week_start_date
FROM daily_plan d
JOIN weekly_plan w ON w.id=d.weekly_plan_id
AND w.user_id=d.user_id
AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE d.id=#{id}
AND d.user_id=#{userId}
AND d.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.id,s.name,s.status,(SELECT ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(t.weight::numeric) FILTER(WHERE t.status='COMPLETED'),0)/NULLIF(SUM(t.weight::numeric),0),2)
FROM task t
WHERE t.stage_id=s.id
AND t.user_id=s.user_id
AND t.deleted_at IS NULL) AS progress
FROM stage s
WHERE s.user_id=#{userId}
AND s.goal_id=#{id}
AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY s.sort_order,s.id
LIMIT 100

SELECT id,name,status,NULL::numeric AS progress
FROM task
WHERE user_id=#{userId}
AND stage_id=#{id}
AND deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY sort_order,id
LIMIT 100
